name: neoteric-memories
description: Neoteric Memories — event-based face-search photo discovery for Neoteric Properties

scripts.build: npm run build -w @neoteric-memories/shared && npm run build -w @neoteric-memories/api && npm run build -w @neoteric-memories/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @neoteric-memories/shared && npm run typecheck -w @neoteric-memories/api && npm run typecheck -w @neoteric-memories/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @neoteric-memories/api && npm run lint -w @neoteric-memories/web
